extracted.intended_audience: patent searchers, IP analysts, patent librarians, and other users of the Derwent Patents Citation Index
extracted.subtask_description: Documentation for using the Derwent Patents Citation Index (DPCI): describes coverage, field codes, search tools, and limits for retrieving cited and citing patent and literature information for patent families.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derwent Patents Citation Index (DPCI) description / content scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Derwent Patents Citation Index (DPCI), produced by Clarivate Analytics, provides access to more than 98 million patent and 11 million literature citations found in more than 11 million patent families. In each update, examiner citations from about 50,000 documents from major patent-issuing authorities are added.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each record in the database describes a patent family for a single invention. The DPCI record provides a view of retrospective technology for an invention (cited patents and literature references) and its impact on subsequent technology (citing patents).

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'cited' and 'citing' references in DPCI
rubrics_metrics.description: Citations referenced by examiners or inventors in patent documents are called 'cited' patents or literature references in the DPCI record and correspond to the search reports that accompany patent publications. When a citation references older inventions/patents, it is also added to the family record as a 'citing' patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This distinction is used to present retrospective technology (what the family cites) and forward impact (what cites the family).

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner and inventor citation jurisdictional coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Examiner citations are provided for family members added to the file from the following patent-issuing authorities: Australia (AU), Belgium (BE), China (CN), Czech Republic (CZ), European Patent Office (EP), France (FR), Germany (DE), Gulf Co-operation Council (GC), Japan (JP), Korea (KR), Luxembourg (LU), Malaysia (MY), Philippines (PH), Netherlands (NL), Russia (RU), Singapore (SG), Spain (ES), Switzerland (CH), United Kingdom (GB), United States (US), and WIPO/PCT (WO); Inventor citations are provided for family members for Australia (AU) (1994-6), Belgium (BE), European Patent Office (EP), France (FR), Germany (DE), Luxembourg (LU), Netherlands (NL), Switzerland (CH), United Kingdom (GB), United States (US) and WIPO/PCT (WO).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limited coverage (1994-6) of citations is included and searchable for Austria (AT) (examiner and inventor), Canada (CA) (Inventor) and Sweden (SE) (examiner and inventor). Use jurisdiction coverage notes when interpreting citation completeness.

rubrics_metrics.name: DPCI family detail limitation and DWPI cross-reference
rubrics_metrics.description: Since DPCI contains limited information about the patent family, the DWPI accession number can be used in DWPI to obtain detailed information, such as abstracts, about cited and citing patents as well as family members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you need abstracts or fuller family detail, cross-search DWPI using the supplied accession numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject Coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: DPCI covers all areas of patentable technology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date Coverage (country-specific)
rubrics_metrics.description: US citations: Jan 1970+; FR, DE, NL citations: Jan 1974+; EP,WO citations: Oct, Dec 1978+; GB, citations: Jan 1979+; CH citations: Jan 1986+; BE citations: Jan 1988+; AU, ES citations: Jan 1993+; JP citations: Jan 1994+; LU citations: Jul 1999+; SG citations: Mar 2001+; GC citations; Jul 2004+; CZ citations: Jun 2006+; KR citations: Jan 2008+; RU citations: Jun 2009+; PH citations: Nov 2009; CN. MY citations: Jan 2010+
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the country-specific start dates to determine how far back citation data is available for particular jurisdictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Update Frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: 52 updates/year
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DPCI is updated weekly; use update dates to identify when a record was last loaded or refreshed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic Coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: International

rubrics_metrics.name: Document Types
rubrics_metrics.description: Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The only document type in DPCI is 'patent'. Literature references are included as cited non-patent literature fields but the database's document type is patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search Fields – Citations (field codes for cited and citing content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Field Name examples: PAR (Cited and citing patents), CTPA (Cited assignee), CTINV (Cited inventor), NPL (Cited non-patent literature), CTDA (Cited patent publication date), CTPN (Cited patent publication number), REF (Cited references - all), CGPA (Citing assignee), CGINV (Citing inventor), CGDA (Citing patent publication date), CGPN (Citing patent publication number), NCP (Number of cited patents), NCBP (Number of citing patents), NR (Number of cited literature references), RI (Relevance category).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples shown: par(EP 743215), par(AUDI), par(20130227), ctpa(AUDI), ctinv(YAMADA E), npl(Toyota and engine), ctda(20001107), ctpn(US 6142907), ref(EP 743215). NCP and NCBP are non-numeric fields representing total unique cited/citing patents for the family.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search Fields – Accession, Patent Numbers, and Identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Field Name examples: Accession number (AN), Any patent number (PNUM). Examples: an(1999610827), pnum(WO 50084), pnum(WO1999050084A1), pnum(WO1999050084), pnum(1999050084).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A unique document identification number is assigned by the information provider (AN). Searching without a field code searches all fields. Enhanced/variant forms of the number are also searchable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search Fields – Application-related fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Application country (APC), Application date(s) (APD/APDA), Application number(s) (APN/APNA). Examples: apc(wo), apd(19990331), apda(20020402), apn(WO 1999EP2218), apna(JP 2000541019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes application, priority application, related application, and related publication number. Non-priority application data is included from DWPI Update 198409.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search Fields – Inventor, Assignee, Company, Language and database fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Author/Inventor (AU/INV), Company information (CO), Patent assignee (PA), Derwent-standardized assignee (DS), Language (LA), From database (FDB). Examples: au("Revermann, K"), co(ISAD ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS), pa(ISAD ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS), ds(FR), la(german), fdb(1008359).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Author names in patent databases are inventors but can be searched using AU. FDB searches the database ID and cannot be searched alone; specify at least one search term then AND it with FDB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search Fields – Publication, Title, Type, and Dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication title (PUB), Publication type (PT), Related publication and application type (DT), Updates (UD), Patent publication date (PD), Patent publication dates - all (PDA), Patent publication number (PN/ PNA), Patent title (TI). Examples: pub(Patents Citation Index), dt(continuation), ud(2013-03-15), pd(20041014), pna(WO1999050084).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: KC (kind code) searches basic, equivalent and related publication country and kind, or the country only. PDA includes main and related publication dates. Use Look Up Patent to validate main publication dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Counts and numeric fields definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Fields: NCP (Number of cited patents), NCBP (Number of citing patents), NR (Number of non-patent (literature) references), NCN (Number of countries), NPF (Number of patents in family).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NCP and NCBP are non-numeric fields representing totals of unique cited/citing patents for the family. NR is numeric. NCN is numeric. Use these to filter or sort by family/citation counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derwent-specific fields and database metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Fields include Derwent enhanced title (DTI), Derwent Week (DW), Document type (DTYPE), First available (FAV), Database (FDB). Examples: dti(hybrid), dw(199952), dtype(patent), fav(2012-12-10).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DTI is Derwent-standardized title; FAV is the first time a document was loaded in DPCI. Use these to isolate records from a single database or to find initial load dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification and class-of-search fields
rubrics_metrics.description: US field of search (CLFS) and other classification searches. Example: clfs(f02D 9/0).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Searches class codes applied by examiners. Use classification codes to refine technology-area searches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look Up lists / Browse Fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Look Up lists are available in the Advanced Search drop-down fields for: Cited assignee, Cited inventor, Citing assignee, Citing inventor, and Publication kind code. Separate Look Up lists are available in search options for cited or citing Patent assignee, Inventor, and Patent number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are useful to validate spellings or the presence of specific data. Terms found in browsing may be selected and automatically added to the Advanced Search form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit Options and Date limiters
rubrics_metrics.description: Limit options are quick and easy ways of searching certain common concepts. Date limiters are available in which you can select single dates or ranges for: Publication date and updated date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use limit options to narrow results quickly by publication or update date ranges.

rubrics_metrics.name: "Narrow results by" limiters (result facets)
rubrics_metrics.description: When results are presented, a right-hand panel shows 'Narrow results by' options with ranked lists of most frequently occurring terms. Limiters include: Patent assignee, Patent assignee country, Inventor, Patent publication country, Publication kind code, Classification (IPC), Classification (CPC), Database (appears when searching multiple databases), and Publication date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click a term in the ranked list to apply it and narrow the search results. This provides an interactive faceted filtering mechanism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look Up Patent feature
rubrics_metrics.description: A Look Up Patent feature lets you enter known details of a patent, including: Number, Patent title, Assignee, Inventor, Publication date, and Application date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Find a link to this toward the top of the Basic Search, Advanced Search, or Command Line Search page; use it to trace a particular patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field code usage tips, examples, and caveats
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples and notes: ctda(20001107), ctda(200011), ctda(2000), pna(JP 2002510007), ti(hybrid). Use adjacency and/or Boolean operators to narrow search results. Prior to certain updates some fields were coded differently (e.g., author present from 1978 forward, language coding limited prior to 199216).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enhanced/variant forms of numbers are searchable. Some data may be missing for early records (e.g., patent dates before 1974). Use the Field codes hyperlink on the Advanced Search page for complete syntax and database code lists. FDB cannot be searched on its own.

rubrics_metrics.name: Terms & Conditions and Support contact
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to the Dialog Standard Terms & Conditions, provider terms apply. Contact: Dialog Global Customer Support Email: Customer@dialog.com; phone numbers provided for North America and outside.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to provider terms for licensing and use conditions; contact customer support for file-content questions.
